title: hypertree grid3 dy reflection
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkHyperTreeGridAxisReflection on a 3D rectilinear HyperTreeGrid reflected along the Y axis.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkCamera](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCamera.html) — camera.
- [vtkDataSetMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetMapper.html) — maps any dataset type to graphics primitives.
- [vtkDoubleArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDoubleArray.html) — double array.
- [vtkHyperTreeGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkHyperTreeGrid.html) — hyper tree grid.
- [vtkHyperTreeGridAxisReflection](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkHyperTreeGridAxisReflection.html) — hyper tree grid axis reflection.
- [vtkHyperTreeGridGeometry](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkHyperTreeGridGeometry.html) — hyper tree grid geometry.
- [vtkHyperTreeGridNonOrientedCursor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkHyperTreeGridNonOrientedCursor.html) — hyper tree grid non oriented cursor.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) — maps scalar values to colors.
- [vtkShrinkFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkShrinkFilter.html) — shrinks cells in any dataset toward their centroid.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
